english.note: Use 睇法 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for someone's opinion, assessment, or perspective.
This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a person's view or opinion.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone's attitude or point of view.
Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing someone's personal way of looking at an issue.
Use this colloquial word when you mean someone's opinion or way of thinking rather than a physical or narrative perspective.
Use this when belief means someone's view or opinion about whether a claim is true, rather than a firm conviction.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for an opinion or a personal point of view.
Use this for a judgement or view formed from noticing something.
Use this for someone's opinion, outlook, or personal view rather than their comprehension of a subject.
Use this for a person's general opinion or assessment rather than an official ruling.
Use 睇法 for someone's opinion, viewpoint, or attitude on a matter.
Use this when viewpoint means someone's way of seeing or opinion, rather than a literal or geometric angle.
